name: slow_tick_continuous_watch
description: A 30 s flick watched continuously, but the client's one-second sampler ran late once: three seconds of wall clock and three seconds of playhead passed between two samples. That is watching, not a seek. A correct tracker credits the 3000 ms and reports no seek; the resulting stream is a plain watch whose first heartbeat is a second late.
viewer: 0-6 s: plays; the sample due at 3 s arrives at 6 s (the tab was busy), with the playhead at 6 s
6-30 s: plays to the end on a regular tick
notes: Divergence 3 (M-12): both trackers size the seek ceiling from the NOMINAL sample interval (SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS x 2 x speed) rather than the elapsed time actually measured between the two samples, so a 3 s late tick at 1x is classified as a seek: watched_ms_total comes out 3000 short and seek_count_increment is 1. The web tracker receives the measured elapsed (MomentumVideo passes it to sample()) and still ignores it for the ceiling; Android's ticker has no measured elapsed at all. The plan lists this under Android; it is shared.
